status: Retrospective benchmark observations; no calibration targets

zhang.species: Male Hartley guinea pig; second cochlear turn, approximately 1-kHz best frequency

fig5.method: Manual centers of the red measured markers in Fig. 5E; green K-derived predictions excluded. Approximate digitization, not raw recordings.
fig5.uncertainty: Sample SD across three animals is calculated from digitized amplitudes; reading resolution is not an SD or confidence interval.

fig4.method: Red measured traces in Fig. 4E extracted by color within separate ISP and EP regions, sampled at 0.5 s. Each trace averages four pulses in one animal (GP267).
fig4.association_caveat: ISP/IS-K and EP/endolymph-K were sequential electrode-position recordings, not simultaneous four-channel measurements. Cohort means/SD do not establish a correlation coefficient.

hou.species: Approximately six-week-old male C57BL/6J and NG2DsRedBAC mice
hou.noise: 120 dB SPL broadband, 3 h on each of two consecutive days
hou.timing: Results p.1955: EP at 2 weeks after transplantation, 5 weeks after noise; Fig.7 labels NE 2W. Timing conflict retained; no chronic model time is assigned.
hou.ep_provenance: Approximate means and error magnitudes transcribed directly from Results p.1955; n=3/group from Fig.7G caption. Values are not inferred from pixels.
hou.flow_provenance: Approximate bar/error readings from Fig.7E in the existing local extraction; n=6/group, mean +/- SD per caption. Volumetric flow, not velocity; spatial mapping to normalized model perfusion is assumed.
hou.uncertainty: Normalize means and SD by the fixed reported control means (101 mV and 3100 um3/s). Denominator uncertainty and cross-endpoint covariance are not propagated; these are not ratio confidence intervals.
hou.exclusions: Flow velocity, ABR and cellular counts are not benchmarks because their observation operators are absent. All four EP/flow groups are retained without assigning model scenarios to treatments or ages.
